justifications.fit: Extends SensorMapping, the machine-map adapter and the existing indices_differential guard pattern rather than adding a mechanism. The Optional expresses exactly the plan's rule that a type-6 entry carries its indices_differential in place of a position; the code and the surrounding comments are reworded to state the TypeError-on-index property as mechanism, with no plan or ticket identifiers. Consistent with the sibling repair that hardened the same guards.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The objective — a type-6 differential flux-loop mapping carries no positioned slot — is implemented exactly: efm_index is `int | None`, the adapter's type-6 branch produces None, and every existing consumer is reached only for a positioned mapping, so the absent slot is now represented as absent rather than as a -1 that a negative-index lookup would silently resolve to the last loop. The plan's convention (type-6 leaves position/area empty and carries indices_differential) is honoured; the change is a faithful tightening of the same rule, not a new design.
justifications.reuse: Reuses the existing per-consumer `indices_differential` guards unchanged and reuses the standard `int | None` optional; introduces no new store path, no new helper and no new dependency. The new test reuses the file's own _build_53_loop_store fixture and read_geometry_table, so it pins the adapter's real output rather than a hand-built mapping.
